edge_colour_class.note: Spanning subgraph of the host keeping exactly the edges whose colour under a total set map {set G} -> C (arbitrary eqType palette) satisfies a colour predicate; one colour is pred1 c. Vertex type of the host (isolated vertices stay); edge set [set e in E(G) | p (col e)], split by p and predC p; predT gives the host, pred0 no edge; values off E(G) are irrelevant; a same-carrier copy of the adjacency is isomorphic through the identity; no map into an empty palette.

edge_colour_class_rel.note: The adjacency of edge_colour_class: (x -- y) && p (col [set x; y]), symmetric because [set x; y] = [set y; x] and irreflexive because the host is.

colour_class.note: Public adapter kept under its old name: a transparent alias of GTBase.edge_colourings.edge_colour_class col p (spanning host carrier, arbitrary eqType palette, total set map, colour predicate), with the original Section binders and Arguments.

cc_rel.note: Public adapter kept under its old name: a transparent alias of GTBase.edge_colourings.edge_colour_class_rel col p, the adjacency (x -- y) && p (col [set x; y]).
